title: Kamanda Mahadev
tagline: Ancient Hilltop Shiva Shrine & Himalayan Solitude in Pauri Garhwal

heroImage.alt: Garhwal Pine Ridge & Valley Vista, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand

overview.short: Sacred hilltop Shiva shrine located 2 km north of Satpuli on the banks of the Nayar River in Pauri Garhwal.
overview.description: Kamanda Mahadev (also revered locally as Kamadeshwar Mahadev) is an ancient Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva situated in the scenic hills of Pauri Garhwal, approximately 2 kilometres north of Satpuli town. Perched amidst quiet pine-clad ridges overlooking the valley of the Purvi Nayar River, the temple is a venerated pilgrimage retreat known for its tranquil Himalayan surroundings, seasonal festivals, and deeply rooted spiritual sanctity.

routes.via: Via Meerut, Bijnor, Kotdwar on NH 534

howToReach.roadNote: Accessible by well-maintained mountain highway NH 534 via Kotdwar and Satpuli; private taxis and state transport buses ply regularly.

topPlaces.name: Satpuli & Nayar River Valley
topPlaces.description: Tranquil riverside town at the confluence of the Eastern and Western Nayar rivers, known for angling, peaceful riverbanks, and scenic Garhwal hillscapes.

image.alt: Satpuli & Nayar River Valley, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand

topPlaces.name: Jwalpa Devi Temple
topPlaces.description: Revered Shakti pilgrimage shrine on the banks of the Navalika (Nayar) River along the Kotdwar-Pauri road, surrounded by scenic green hills.

image.alt: Jwalpa Devi Temple, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand

topPlaces.name: Lansdowne
topPlaces.description: Quiet, historic cantonment hill station set amidst dense pine and oak forests, offering panoramic snow views of the Chaukhamba and Trishul peaks.

topPlaces.name: Tarkeshwar Mahadev Temple
topPlaces.description: Ancient Shiva sanctuary situated at 2,092m altitude, nestled inside a dense sacred grove of towering deodar and cedar trees in the Garhwal Himalayas.

image.alt: Tarkeshwar Mahadev Temple, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Kamanda Mahadev?
faq.a: The best time to visit Kamanda Mahadev is Mar – Jun and Sep – Nov when weather in the Garhwal foothills is pleasant and road travel along NH 534 is smooth.

faq.q: How do I reach Kamanda Mahadev?
faq.a: Kamanda Mahadev is located 2 km north of Satpuli town in Pauri Garhwal. The nearest railway station is Kotdwar (52 km) and nearest airport is Jolly Grant Airport in Dehradun (115 km).

faq.q: How many days are enough for Kamanda Mahadev?
faq.a: 2 days are ideal to visit Kamanda Mahadev temple and explore nearby attractions like Satpuli river valley, Jwalpa Devi temple, and Lansdowne.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost near Kamanda Mahadev?
faq.a: Budget guesthouses like GMVN Satpuli start around ₹800–₹1,800/night, while resort stays in nearby Lansdowne range from ₹3,500 to ₹8,500/night.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit near Kamanda Mahadev?
faq.a: Top attractions include the Satpuli & Nayar River Valley, Jwalpa Devi Temple, Lansdowne cantonment hill station, and Tarkeshwar Mahadev Temple.
